Main content

This main-layout article explains a carefully bounded change to a long-running system and starts with the business context that motivated the work.

It then describes the technical design, the data that is intentionally retained, the data that is intentionally discarded, and why those choices reduce risk.

The article includes operational details for retries, typed failures, monitoring, and a staged rollout so readers can understand the trade-offs without a browser.

The final section documents tests, known limits, and the next explicit decision point instead of promising an unbounded platform that the team does not need.
